qualityNotes: No profession, company, sector, conversion or customer identity is exposed by these endpoints.
Brazil domain metrics are national estimates and are not Minas Gerais or Belo Horizonte rankings.
Keyword suggestions carry updated_at 2026-03-06; the 2026-09-08 collection date is observation date, not metric freshness.
BH suggestions include volume 10 and 0; those values do not prove absence of demand.
CPC fields are preserved in raw structured data but omitted from narrative because cpc and cpcDollars are not consistently comparable; no conversion was made.

Traffic values from domain_keywords and domain_top_pages are distinct endpoint estimates and must not be summed. Minusa material-rodante row shows traffic 15 while Top Pages shows 1; both are preserved.
Brand, careers/vagas, branch and unrelated product terms are marked as context or excluded from lead interpretation.
Açomec and Trackunit no-data responses are endpoint limitations in BR, not proof of zero traffic or zero demand.
SERP entries preserve AI overview, PAA, videos, images, local packs and organic entries; feature ordinals must not be called universal Google rankings.
Sector suggestion groups use Brazil locId 2076, not a city-level dataset. One initial florestal request failed at transport and the retry succeeded; the failed attempt is preserved as status=error.
Sector searched-keyword records with no volume/updated_at field remain absent in this normalized JSON; they are not coerced to zero.
Sector updated_at values are heterogeneous (2025-09-28 through 2026-09-06, plus 2026-03/other dates in related rows); they are not one coherent monthly snapshot.
Related suggestions are provider-limited samples (for example, the agro group returned the first 300 and reported 245 omitted); they are not a complete keyword universe.
